standard_prerequisites.name: The maps between the small and big toposes
standard_prerequisites.statement: a_X and epsilon_X with a_X^{-1}F = epsilon_X^{-1}pi_X^{-1}F, and the fact that epsilon_{X,*} is the identity on underlying presheaves while pullback by epsilon_X is ph sheafification.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the starting point of part (1) at source lines 1901-1907.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of pi_X^{-1}F and its sheaf property
standard_prerequisites.statement: pi_X^{-1}F is computed by Gamma(Y_etale, f_small^{-1}F) and is a sheaf for the ph (and smooth, syntomic, fppf, fpqc) topology (the author's lemma-describe-pullback, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It gives epsilon_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = pi_X^{-1}F at source lines 1902-1909.

standard_prerequisites.name: Higher direct images as associated sheaves of cohomology presheaves
standard_prerequisites.statement: For an abelian sheaf H on (Spaces/X)_ph the sheaf R^p epsilon_{X,*}H is the sheafification of U -> H^p_ph(U,H) on the small etale site (Cohomology on Sites, declared as a tagged source pointer).
standard_prerequisites.use: It turns the vanishing into a statement about classes over schemes at source lines 1920-1929.

standard_prerequisites.name: Cohomology agrees over (Spaces/U)_ph and (Sch/U)_ph
standard_prerequisites.statement: The restriction identification H^p((Spaces/U)_ph, -) = H^p((Sch/U)_ph, -) used for a scheme U (the author's lemma-compare-cohomology-other-topologies, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the second identification of the displayed chain at source lines 1937-1938.

standard_prerequisites.name: The scheme case of the comparison
standard_prerequisites.statement: The corresponding statements for schemes: the description of the pullback in the schemes version and V_n for all n, i.e. the vanishing in the scheme case (Etale Cohomology, declared as tagged source pointers).
standard_prerequisites.use: It finishes part (2) at source lines 1941-1952.

core_obligations: Part (1): identify a_X^{-1}F with the ph sheaf pi_X^{-1}F, use that epsilon_{X,*} is the identity on underlying presheaves and read off both identities from the explicit description of pi_X^{-1} (source lines 1901-1909).

Part (2), reduction: replace the vanishing by a statement about classes xi in H^p_ph(U, a_X^{-1}F) for U a scheme, since every object of the small etale site has a covering by schemes (source lines 1912-1929).
Part (2), identification: rewrite H^p_ph(U, a_X^{-1}F) as cohomology over (Sch/U)_ph using the author's comparison of topologies plus the general restriction fact (source lines 1930-1940).

Part (2), conclusion: match (a_X^{-1}F)|_{Sch/U} with the schemes version of the pullback and apply the scheme statement to find an etale covering on which the class dies, then transport back (source lines 1941-1954).

proof_roadmap.step: Part (1) from the description of pi_X^{-1}F and the identity of epsilon_{X,*} on presheaves.
Announce the reduction of part (2) to schemes, with the author's remark that the reader is urged to skip the proof.
Rewrite the vanishing as a statement about classes over a scheme U and identify the ph cohomology over (Spaces/U)_ph with that over (Sch/U)_ph.
Apply the scheme case to kill the class on an etale covering and transport back to U.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-comparison-ph-etale at source lines 1888-1898: for a sheaf F on X_etale one has epsilon_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = pi_X^{-1}F and a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = F, and for torsion abelian F one has R^i epsilon_{X,*}(a_X^{-1}F) = 0 for i > 0. The author's proof at source lines 1900-1955 proves part (1) from the explicit description of pi_X^{-1} together with the fact (the author's lemma-describe-pullback, retained as context) that pi_X^{-1}F is already a ph sheaf, and then proves part (2) by reducing to the case of schemes: using that higher direct images of epsilon_{X,*} are the sheaves associated to the presheaves U -> H^p_ph(U,-), that every object of the small etale site has a covering by schemes, an identification of the cohomology over (Spaces/U)_ph with that over (Sch/U)_ph (the author's lemma-compare-cohomology-other-topologies, retained as context, plus a general restriction fact declared as a pointer), and finally the corresponding scheme statement (a cross-chapter pointer, used twice). The author explicitly notes that the reader is urged to skip the proof of part (2); that remark is reproduced verbatim.
